tool_input.args: Panels classified as micrograph: A, B, C (C also contains plot sub-images). Caption: (A) Image depicting the different clusters identified in a SNL lung section based on spatial transcriptomic analysis. Scale bar, 2 mm. (B) H&E image of the lung section from A) (left) and manual annotation of different regions (right); LUSC (S1, S2, S3) and LUAD (A1 and A2). Scale bar, 2 mm. (C) H&E image of the lung section from A), annotated with regions of LUSC and LUAD, and corresponding spatial plots depicting the distribution of the indicated mRNAs. Scale bar, 1 mm.

Panels classified as plot: C (spatial expression plots overlaid on tissue), D (GSEA enrichment plots), E (bar graph of log2 fold change for 8 genes, each bar labeled with a p-value, no visible individual data points or error bars).

Panels classified as plot: C (spatial expression heatmap plots, no error bars), D (GSEA enrichment plots, line plots with NES/FDR/p values, no error bars), E (bar graph, single bars per gene with p-values annotated, no visible error bars).
